message_buffer start-address - OCP offset from PRAM BASE address represents the actual OCP maddr[17:0] of PRAM 16 MSBs [17:2] are used as start pointer to RAM. 2 LSBs [1:0] are dropped and assumed to be 2'b00
defines the number of words allocated to the message-buffer

0 - message-buffer is disabled. OCP will continue to work normally but interface to PRAM will be disabled. freeze current status: wr_ptr and len keep their value. 1 - message-buffer is anabled. OCP write will be converted to PRAM write at rise - initialize counter and pointer to 0 (rise=init/restart)

0 - stop write to buffer when buffer is full (no message overwrite) 1 - cyclic-mode - continue write to buffer when it is full. write-pointer will wrap to start-address and continue write (overwrite old messages)

write-pointer in words (increments by 1), points to the next empty address. Initial value is mem_msg_buf_start_addr[17:2] (OCP address divide by 4). Last message was written to (msg_buf_wr_ptr-1) When dumping the buffer content, need to start read from: (msg_buf_wr_ptr-msg_buf_length)*4 and consider cyclic address wrap. Also need to add PRAM base-address as ocp_maddr[23:18] Dumping the buffer content is done using direct PRAM access read from base 0xD0_0000 + offset of mem_msg_buf_start_addr[17:0]
Number of words written to message-buffer. Max value is mem_msg_buf_size.

for use in extreme cases when need to switch response register from "steady wait" to "no_req". when set to "1", the response register status field is forced to "no_req". "steady wait" means "wait" that can't switched to "in progress". in order to bring the request register to steady wait, there is a need to set its priority to a number higher than 9. and read after the setting, if it is wait - it will be a steady wait. after using it - it should be written to "0", to enable regular operation.

register.description: VLUT - contains 2 VLUT words, each 14 bits: when address is even -> [15:2] when address is odd -> [29:16]
MBLR - contains 2 MBLR words, each 10 bits: when address is even -> [15:6] when address is odd -> [25:16]
